question: Which of the following states has processed the highest amount of e-waste during 2024-25, as per the Government of India report in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **India Government Report of July 2025**, **Uttar Pradesh** emerged as the leading state in **e-waste processing** for the financial year 2024-25.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has developed significant infrastructure for **e-waste management**, including government-approved recycling facilities and private sector participation.
 
• The state has also implemented robust **awareness campaigns** and compliance mechanisms to tackle e-waste issues efficiently.
 
• Policies under the **E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2016** have been actively enforced in Uttar Pradesh, ensuring effective disposal and recycling of electronic waste.
 
• Efforts to engage manufacturers under the **Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)** framework have boosted the collection and processing rates in the state.
